title: Ink and line art
description: Dark ink lines with flat or hatched fills in a few colours, like a printed comic or woodcut.

art_style.outline_policy: Ink line of consistent weight; line weight is part of the style.
art_style.shading_policy: Flat tones or hatching; no soft gradients.

native_size_guidance: Draw at about twice the final display size and reduce once with a smooth filter; keep every asset in a set at the same scale.
avoid: Do not vary the line weight between assets.
Do not use more than the chosen ink colours.
